name: Hate from the Afterlife
source:
Know the story of Marta and Leyla, two women destined to meet over and over again in several lifetimes.

An interactive novel based on the short story "Odio desde la otra vida" by writer Roberto Arlt.

[From [url=https://mapedorr.itch.io/hate-from-the-afterlife]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
了解玛塔和莱拉的故事，这两个女人注定会在几辈子中一次又一次地相遇。

根据作家罗伯托·阿尔特的短篇小说“Odio desde la otra vida”改编的互动小说。

[来自[url=https://mapedorr.itch.io/hate-from-the-afterlife]Itch.io[/url]]
